messages.subject: R952 report complete
messages.body: Completed the source-only R952 investigation and saved the 1,550-word report at bench/results/2026-10-15-pr6-recovery-audit/research-round952-v1.txt. I pinned SyclKittens to 94321133edca6f953cf37d4f0a5b6f09558de98e, checked arXiv v1, and compared its PVC cache-prefetch pipeline with XeTLA and BMG-capable SYCL-TLA; this surfaces design questions but establishes no B570 performance or selected-K/expert wins. Remaining work is B570 compiler/lowering verification and Main-owned component/model measurements when a concrete implementation question arises; this knowledge collection makes no implementation recommendation.
